VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to verify acceptance criteria satisfaction. While the agent claims all 23 tests pass and the fix is complete, there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test output, code diff, or artifacts) to corroborate these claims. The self-report class (SELF) has the lowest evidentiary weight and cannot establish that the acceptance criteria were actually met without supporting documentation.
